---
name: Research finding
about: Record a discovery insight with evidence and counter-evidence
title: "[DISCOVERY] "
labels: research
assignees: ""
---

## Participant / context (anonymised)
Role, operating model, and date. Do not include personal identifiers.

## Observation / quote
State whether this is a quote, observed behaviour, or interpretation. Include permission status for quotes.

## Recent example
What happened, when, and how was it resolved?

## Consequence
What was the operational impact, if known?

## Counter-evidence
What might contradict this insight?

## Product implication
What should be reconsidered? Do not jump directly to a feature.
